message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was **2026-08-30 05:10 IST to 2026-08-31 05:10 IST** (2026-08-29 23:40 UTC to 2026-08-30 23:40 UTC). This primary-product scan read, normalized, combined, and deduplicated only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

No newly reported or substantively updated vulnerability was verified in this window as directly affecting a product in the assigned primary inventory.

**Findings**

None.

**MongoDB ecosystem sweep**

MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services were checked.

No in-window MongoDB finding was verified. Several MongoDB Connector for BI records surfaced during the sweep, including CVE-2026-81490, CVE-2026-81517, CVE-2026-81518, CVE-2026-81520, and CVE-2026-77586, but the authoritative CVE metadata places their publication on August 28, before this scan's cutoff. A CERT-In MongoDB notice was originally issued August 17; its August 30 page update did not establish a new vulnerability disclosure. These items were excluded rather than reported as new. Sources: [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) and [CERT-In CIVN-2026-0413](https://www.cert-in.org.in/s2cMainServlet?VLCODE=CIVN-2026-0413&pageid=PUBVLNOTES01).

**Possible matches needing review**

None.

**Closing**

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan window. Continue routine monitoring.
